user.title: Circadian Scenes
user.description: Adds Circadian Scenes to the sidebar. Create and edit rooms from there — one integration, as many areas as you need. Daylight that follows the sun between your scenes.

empty.extrapolation: No circadian scenes yet. Create one to start lighting a room from the sun.
empty.extrapolation_body: Circadian Scenes blend your room’s lights between solar events — dawn, sunrise, noon, sunset, and dusk — so brightness and color follow the day.
empty.extrapolation_example: Create a scene for a room from an area, or auto configure all areas that have lights.
empty.auto_configure_body: Auto configure creates a circadian scene for every area that has lights, using the default theme. You can edit variables and themes here anytime — lights update the next time a scene runs.
empty.area_no_scenes: No scenes yet — create one for this area
empty.select_scene: Select a scene to get started
empty.select_scene_body: Choose a scene from the list to edit its lights through the day, or add a scene from an area.
empty.no_areas: No Home Assistant areas yet. Add floors and areas in Settings, then come back.

library.title: Variables & themes
library.hint: Changing a variable or theme updates scenes that still use it. Lights change on the next activate or automatic update — not instantly.
library.variable_edit_hint: Color and brightness are shared by every theme or light that still uses this variable.
library.palette_edit_hint: A palette is five colors. Lights that use it pick a slot; changing the palette updates those lights the next time a scene runs.
library.theme_hint: Open a theme to edit its color and brightness at each solar event. Changes apply to every circadian scene that still uses the theme; per-light overrides stay as they are.
library.theme_edit_hint: Editing {name} changes every circadian scene that still uses this theme. Per-light overrides on those scenes stay as they are.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: These settings apply to every room. Changes take effect immediately.
settings.automatically_update_lights_on_helper: After you activate a scene, lights keep adjusting on the interval from Settings so the room follows the sun. Tap to turn this off for every room.
settings.automatically_update_lights_off_helper: Automatic updates are off. Activating a scene applies lights once. Tap to turn updates back on for every room.
settings.automatically_update_lights_interval_hel: After a scene is activated, keep updating the lights this often with the same transition length (target = how the room should look at the end of the transition). 0 turns automatic updates off for every room — same as the control at the top of the list.
settings.dusk_minimum_time_of_day_helper: To avoid lights dimming too much, too early. Applies to every circadian scene and theme.

save_warn.title: Update external scenes?
save_warn.text: Saving will change these Home Assistant scenes that were not created by Circadian Scenes: {scenes}.
